Models are increasingly specializing, while applications combine different intelligences for greater value. Consumer AI applications include personal agents and coding tools for small businesses. Acharya warns founders against thinking too small, identifies a consumer builder renaissance, and notes the rise of "luxury software."

title: Arm 成立 36 年来首颗自研芯片：台积电 3nm 工艺
content: Arm unveiled its first in-house chip at Hot Chips 2026, marking its 36-year history. The AGI CPU targets agentic AI, featuring up to 136 Neoverse V3 cores on TSMC 3nm N3P process with dual-chiplet design. The 100-billion-transistor chip reaches 3.7GHz with 2MB L2 cache per core, 300W TDP, and sub-100ns memory latency. It supports 96 PCIe Gen6 lanes, CXL 3.0, DDR5-8800, and up to 6TB memory capacity.

content: A 24-year-old former security guard won recognition at the TRAE AI Creativity Competition on August 21 for his project "Move Your Neck," a motion-sensing game encouraging cervical spine exercises. The competition, running from June 16, required no technical background; participants submitted ideas and developed them into functional demos. Over two months, 37,000 entrants produced 14,000 projects. Eight of eleven judges voted for the former guard's work, with guest reviewers Tim and Hu Yanbin testing his product on stage.
